data.gender_notes: Kedarnath is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Named after Lord Shiva, who is believed to reside in the Kedarnath mountain. The name Kedarnath is derived from Kedara, a name of Lord Shiva. The name Kedarnath carries the meaning “Lord of Kedara” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Kedarnath usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of kedara and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kedarnath total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

data.cultural_impact: Kedarnath is a revered name in Hinduism, synonymous with the sacred Kedarnath Temple located in the Garhwal Himalayas. The significance of this name extends beyond the physical location as it represents the deep-rooted spiritual connection the Indian subcontinent shares with Lord Shiva. It serves as a reminder of the richness and diversity of the Indian cultural heritage, as well as the devotional practices embedded in it. Every year, thousands of pilgrims from all over the world embark on the journey to Kedarnath, making it a powerful symbol of unity in diversity.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Kedarnath holds immense spiritual significance as it is the manifestation of Lord Shiva, who is believed to reside in the Kedarnath mountains. According to Hindu mythology, this place is one of the twelve 'Jyotirlingas', where Lord Shiva is believed to have appeared as a radiating column (linga) of light. Visiting Kedarnath and seeking blessings from Lord Shiva is considered a pious act, intellectually inspiring countless souls to contemplate the ultimate truth and transcend the material world. Devotees believe that by connecting spiritually with Lord Shiva through the name Kedarnath, they can attain Moksha (liberation from the cycle of birth and death). The name thus carries a profound sense of inner peace, eternal joy, and freedom beyond the material world, making it a source of inspiration for many on the spiritual path.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Kedarnath signifies the abode of Lord Shiva, a place of deep spiritual significance for Hindus. The name embodies the divine presence of the Lord, encircled by snow-capped mountains and steeped in sacred traditions. It is a pilgrimage site, where one seeks peace, purification, and union with the ultimate reality.

name_in_real_life.story: Amit Kedarnath from Bali, Indonesia embodies the meaning of Kedarnath - "Lord of Kedara". Growing up in a Hindu family, they were taught to honor the spiritual significance of their name and live according to dharma.
